name: Jack Henry / Symitar (Core)
description: Member profiles, geography, age, product holdings, and consumer-loan records. Resolves who is in the population.

name: MeridianLink
description: Consumer loan origination, timelines, and disclosure delivery records.

name: HUNA (Mortgage System)
description: The mortgage system of record. Application-to-closing timeline, mortgage disclosures, and outcomes. The heart of the mortgage compliance query.

name: SharePoint
description: Complaint records and document management, including disclosures on file and ESIGN consent.

name: Medallia (Voice of Member, social listening)
description: Member surveys, sentiment, and experience feedback. A primary source of trends and of the dissatisfaction language that signals a complaint.

name: Member Communications
description: Emails and interactions across the loan lifecycle. Source of interaction counts, trigger words, and dissatisfaction language.

name: Regulatory Rules Engine
description: The encoded rules (TRID timelines, ECOA, ESIGN, GLBA, CFPB) that drive the tests, checklists, and calendars.
